n37d2400007a546ed9ec627f820569d9db1.object: "The iceClass value of a ship must be an IRI denoting an iceClassValue."
"Source TRF-010, Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof, clause 1.8: ships are assigned to ice class IA Super, IA, IB, IC, II, or III."

https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF010IceCla.object: "Representation constraint for TRF-010. The source defines six controlled ice-class values, but the supplied ontology and representation mappings do not provide canonical IRIs for those six value individuals. Accordingly, this shape constrains the object property to iceClassValue IRIs without inventing value IRIs or asserting an enumeration."
